description: Client-side script for managing Staffing Plan form in ERPNext, including setup, validation, and calculation functions for staffing details.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for Staffing Plan form, configuring queries for designation and department fields.

methods.name: designation
methods.description: Event handler for changes in designation in Staffing Plan Detail, triggers position count update.

methods.name: vacancies
methods.description: Event handler for changes in vacancies, validates and updates position counts.

methods.name: current_count
methods.description: Event handler for current count change, updates position counts.

methods.name: estimated_cost_per_position
methods.description: Event handler for estimated cost per position, updates total estimated cost.
